security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Optional looks and effects for the Arnold server
bundle.longDescription: Installs optional client mods for Minecraft 26.3 on the Arnold server. Downloads are limited to Modrinth CDN and this project's GitHub Releases. No game-server addresses are stored in the app.
